name: Take the Bait
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during combat on an opponent's turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn. Untap all attacking creatures and goad them. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and planeswalkers you control this turn.

needs.what: a one-shot, this-turn, combat-only prevention over the permanents a player controls that match a selector ('planeswalkers you control'), matched on the damaged permanent's current characteristics and controller as the damage would be dealt (615.1), alongside the combat_only prevent_damage shield over the player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage with combat_only covers the seat ('you') but not its permanents; prevent_damage_permanent with combat_only installs a PermanentShield on each object resolve_pool returns at resolution, so a planeswalker that enters or changes control later in the turn (e.g. during the additional combat phase this card creates) is judged by the board the spell saw; prevent_combat_damage is keyed to the dealer, not the recipient. The casting restriction is no longer blocked: it is cast_only_during {turn: opponents, phase: combat}
